attributes.action: Restrict fireworks to licensed, low-noise displays, set dates and a 10pm curfew
attributes.additional_details:
Fireworks cause considerable distress to animals, vulnerable people and communities across the country.

Celebrations such as Bonfire Night, Diwali and New Year’s Eve should not mean days or weeks of fireworks before and afterwards. Fireworks are frequently set off without warning, leaving pet owners trying to comfort terrified animals, while livestock and wildlife can also suffer.

Unpredictable explosions can be distressing for people with PTSD, autism, sensory sensitivities, dementia etc
attributes.background: We call on the Government to introduce legislation similar to the Republic of Ireland, restricting sale and use of fireworks to licensed professionals. Displays should use low-noise fireworks only, be permitted on designated dates, including Bonfire Night, Diwali and New Year’s Eve.

rejection.details:
We have two petitions that have opened very recently which call for what your petition is seeking. You may wish to sign them.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893

Ban all loud fireworks and only allow silent ones to be sold in the UK
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786349
